influences.name: Brandy
influences.context: "If it wasn't for Whitney Houston, there would be no me, because she was the possibility for me," Brandy told The Columbus Dispatch in 2012. "She was the vision of my dreams actually coming true, and she meant everything to me."

influences.name: Aretha Franklin
influences.context: Aretha Franklin, the first woman inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, was known as "Auntie Ree" at the Houston household.

influences.name: Cissy Houston
influences.context: As the youngest child and only daughter of Emily (Cissy) Houston, a professional gospel singer...she had started as a child singing backup in her mother's choir
